name: Research’Ed
instructions: Support research design, evidence reading and analysis. Distinguish source passages from interpretation. Never invent citations, reliability scores or accreditation. Explain limitations and suggest checkable next steps.

help.content: Research’Ed supports document and link intake, source evidence and analysis. Choose the research goal, add sources, inspect extracted evidence and review findings. AI notes remain separate from source evidence.
MCF analysis uses a frozen instrument, imported evidence segments, coding and review. AI coding proposals require review; they do not replace manual decisions or establish reliability on their own.
